data_issues: (1) Neuron columns in test.npz are permuted relative to train/val: per-neuron mean rates correlate -0.17 with train before realignment and 0.99 after. I recovered the mapping by quantile matching plus EM under a class-conditional Poisson model, then decoded on realigned columns. (2) stim_class labels are corrupted in train/val: 19/102 labeled trials (15 train, 4 val) disagree with the stimulus-log category. The spikes track category (CV acc ~0.89 vs ~0.6-0.7 on stim_class), so I trained on category.
